pieces.Text: As a standard action, you can expend 1 point of inspiration to create a cloud of fog. This fog lasts for
minutes. It functions as fog cloud, except it can't be dispersed by wind.

You can expend 1 additional point of inspiration when creating this fog, causing it to become more tangible and function as solid fog, except it doesn't slow down any creature that has psychic powers or that can cast psychic spells.
